claims.normative_claim: Historical Session 12 closeout is byte-preserved and no longer treated as current semantic authority after successor repair begins.
The successor closeout, not the historical closeout, determines current GO_SESSION_13.
Private planning/execution authority remains outside every Git repository, package, public proof, example and CI artifact.
Session 10/11 canonical authority and Acceptance semantics remain compatible and unchanged.
Foundry records statement-level source authority, not merely source-file metadata.
Illustrative examples cannot become exact mandatory requirements without explicit authority.
Explicit exact-content requirements remain exact.
Explicit non-goals cannot become mandatory through model inference.
Tech-spec mechanisms remain distinct from product outcomes unless explicitly authoritative.
Active source conflicts remain visible until disposition.
Superseded source remains historical and loses active authority.
Untrusted instruction-like source content cannot control Foundry roles/tools/authority.
Blind intent role has an operational information boundary excluding implementation/tests by default.
Implementation-informed mode is explicit and degraded.
Intent Model contains case-specific actors, outcomes, invariants, states/transitions, recovery expectations, non-goals, ambiguities and conflicts where supported.
Goal/Obstacle analysis is case-specific and uses semantic stopping criteria rather than fixed boilerplate/depth.
Pre-mortem produces causally distinct case-specific failure narratives.
Pre-mortem cannot create mandatory authority or implementation fixes.
Contract Proposer compiles independently settleable typed criteria rather than a generic owner-confirmation placeholder.
Every mandatory-source proposed criterion has traceable source authority.
Suggested enhancements remain distinguishable from mandatory-source proposals.
Adversarial audit inspects the actual candidate and produces case-specific findings.
Omitted-obligation / under-specification witness works.
Over-specification witness works.
Material ambiguity witness routes to owner.
Weak-oracle witness prevents false readiness/blocking.
Non-goal leakage is detected.
Implementation leakage is detected.
Compound criteria are detected/split where appropriate.
Every material audit finding receives exactly one typed disposition.
Standard revision cap is one.
Deep revision cap is two.
Valid witnesses pass.
Near-valid alternatives pass where intended.
Adversarial superficial behavior fails.
Ambiguity witnesses result in owner decision rather than silent inference.
Faithful mode prohibits unsupported enhancements.
Clarifying mode separates recommended interpretation from authority.
Enhanced mode keeps all added suggestions non-authoritative.
Verification Pattern selection is derived from criterion/failure/oracle semantics rather than a fixed global subset.
Material contract mutation changes verification-pattern/capability selection.
Non-material wording mutation does not cause spurious material selection change.
Contract readiness means readiness for owner confirmation, not runtime establishment.
NOT_ELIGIBLE remains distinct from NOT_READY.
Owner projection binds the actual semantic candidate/audit/witness/pattern artifacts.
Session 11 case-operator disposition remains the only route to Acceptance Contract authority.
Deep uses two frozen blind semantic paths before synthesis.
Each Deep path produces an independent contract candidate or structured critique in addition to intent.
Deep semantic calls remain stateless with no cross-path conversational state.
Same-provider/model-family Deep runs do not claim provider/model-family independence.
Current quality-critical semantic qualification uses the approved GPT-5.6 policy.
Historical GPT-5.2 calls remain preserved but cannot establish corrected semantic qualification.
No model is introduced into Session 11 evidence settlement authority.
Historical five-case comparison remains preserved and is classified as exposed regression evidence for the repair.
Final semantic evaluation scores canonical Contract Foundry outputs, not merely raw model implication/token coverage.
Hidden adjudication is frozen and independently reviewed before final outcome-bearing scoring.
Baseline evaluation is semantically neutral and does not require Provan internal identifiers.
Paired comparisons use the same current strong model/model family where practical and disclose compute differences.
At least one clean post-repair held-out comparison is preserved, or the absence of a clean heldout is explicitly disclosed and qualification narrowed.
Real-use cases demonstrate materially case-specific semantic output.
Final Provan dogfood exercises the qualified semantic Standard path, not Tier-0 no-model only.
Public docs and capability matrix match successor maturity.
One authoritative successor wheel is bound to the final corrected implementation.
Fresh-install behavior resolves from installed package, not checkout.
Execution remains unavailable.
Challenge execution remains unavailable.
Session 13 remains unimplemented.
Enterprise capability remains unimplemented.
Branch, package, proof and public-artifact sensitivity gates pass.
Fresh reviewers bind the exact corrected implementation, successor wheel, pre-review root and every G12R claim.
Successor Gate 12 sets GO_SESSION_13:YES only if the semantic correction is fully qualified.
Every run freezes exact source bytes in an immutable Source Bundle before statement extraction, and later reads can only verify digest continuity.
Source coverage accounts for every relevant span or structured node as semantic, explicitly non-semantic, explicitly ignored, or unresolved, with no silent material omission.
A post-blind implementation-aware stage maps frozen semantic obligations to exact Session 10 candidate surfaces without rewriting intent or creating authority.
Successor semantic qualification uses clean untouched holdouts spanning distinct semantic domains, including a clean no-friction control.
Qualification is decided by hard material-correctness gates that composite or macro scores cannot override.
Semantic equivalence uses deterministic checks plus at least two fresh blind arm-independent adjudicators, records disagreement, and cannot be established by one self-judge or token matcher.
Arm B is a genuine stateless proposer, fresh adversarial reviewer, and revision sequence with a compute budget reasonably comparable to Deep.
Final hidden holdouts and adjudication are operationally isolated from the implementation agent and environment.
Final hidden qualification is one-shot after semantic implementation and policy freeze; a material failure closes the successor partially and cannot be tuned away with replacement cases.
Deep is DEGRADED only after meeting the complete semantic floor without materially regressing Standard and only for declared independence limits.
Verification Pattern selection rejects select-all or near-universal portfolios lacking a distinct criterion, failure, oracle, or capability basis per selection.

Material contract mutation changes the verification plan only through portfolio membership, criterion-pattern binding, dimension, oracle, or capability semantics and does not require artificial pattern-ID churn.
Every proposed v2 contract has an individual compatibility justification; existing semantics are reused or narrowly accompanied where possible.
Successor evidence includes semantic run-to-run stability, compact owner-review rendering, actual per-case measurements, and stateless Standard audit and revision roles.

Semantic public real use, stability and final semantic dogfood complete before the final implementation/model/prompt/policy freeze, and hidden qualification runs only against the resulting authoritative wheel.
Post-blind implementation mapping binds exact immutable candidate bytes and digest; mutable candidates remain explanatory and cannot reach owner-confirmation readiness.

Final qualification uses at least six isolated untouched holdouts across payment/state, permission/identity, API/schema, recovery, AI/tool authority and clean/no-friction domains with a frozen semantic coverage matrix.
Hidden semantic equivalence prefers different qualified model/provider families; same-family agreement additionally requires a fresh protected evaluator/reviewer to verify every material disposition.
Qualification requires zero unaccounted material source content and zero material content wrongly classified non-semantic or ignored.
Every adjudicated material obligation maps to supported candidate surfaces or explicit unresolved/not-discoverable state, with zero unsupported mappings claimed as supported.
Every adjudicated material verification dimension is covered or explicitly unavailable/not-applicable, and no materially irrelevant pattern is selected.
Standard and Deep semantic-stage ceilings permit separately bounded, receipted source-classification fan-out under per-run call/token/cost and cumulative Session 12 budget limits.
Frozen Source Bundles are private-local, excluded from telemetry/public/client-safe/package surfaces, and governed by digest-bound cleanup/deletion semantics.
YAML comments are coverage-accounted contextual/untrusted spans, cannot silently create mandatory authority, and cannot disappear through parser comment loss.
Run-to-run stability is judged through blinded semantic equivalence of material obligations, non-goals, exact-content rules, ambiguities and verification dimensions rather than byte identity.
Standard and Deep report actual per-case wall time, calls, tokens and cost without unsupported percentile claims.
